refnamediv.refpurpose: Backend API for uploading reports. This interface shall be implemented by services linked into /run/systemd/report.upload/

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.Report.Uploader is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.
Backend API for uploading reports. This interface shall be implemented by services linked into /run/systemd/report.upload/

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# Backend API for uploading reports. This interface shall be implemented by services linked into /run/systemd/report.upload/ interface io.systemd.Report.Uploader
# Upload a report now. method Upload( # Report data as JSON variant. Either this field or reportData (below) have to be specified. This mode is used if signing is not used, and hence a precise binary formatting of the JSON data is not relevant. report: ?object, # Report data in Base64. Either this field or report (above) have to be specified. This mode is used if signing is enabled, as a precise binary formatting of the JSON data is important to authenticate the signature. This data contains a JSON-SEQ compliant stream of objects, the first being the report, the following ones signature objects. reportData: ?string ) -> ()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.Report.Uploader shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.Report.Uploader.Upload '{}' invokes its Upload() method.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd.Report.Uploader interface was added in version 261.
